:::{#cor-linear-is-affine}
#### Every linear map is affine

Every [linear map](#def-linear-map) $f : \reals^p \to \reals^m$
is an [affine map](#def-affine-map) with [offset](#def-affine-offset) $\vzero$.
With $\matr{A}$ the [matrix of $f$](#def-matrix-of-linear-map),

$$
f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx + \vzero
\quad \text{for all } \vx \in \reals^p.
$$ {#eq-linear-is-affine}

:::

::: proof

If $f$ is linear, @thm-linear-map-matrix gives a matrix $\matr{A}$
with

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(\vx) &= \matr{A}\vx \\
&= \matr{A}\vx + \vzero,
\end{aligned}
$$

which is an [affine map](#def-affine-map) with [offset](#def-affine-offset) $\vec{b} = \vzero$.

:::
